$comment: 3-star scorecard (docs/new-slot/STAKE_3_STAR.md §3). OUR rubric, not Stake's: one copy per reviewer. Scores use Stake's scale only: 0, 0.33, 0.67, 1, 1.33, 1.67, 2, 2.33, 2.67, 3. reviewerScore = min(weighted mean, lowest pillar + 0.67), and capped at 2.0 when any cap is true. Ship gate (STAKE_3_STAR.md §3): every reviewer's reviewerScore >= 2.67 and no pillar < 2.33 for any reviewer.
